note: Every organisation, place, person, figure and sentence in this file is invented. Hosts use the reserved .example top-level domain. Nothing here is, or is derived from, a real source.

cases.title: A revenue figure beside a vague plant remark
cases.rationale: The dollar figure is revenue. The "possible new plant" has no site and no commitment. Neither the figure nor the timeline sentence corroborates a project.

documents.title: A revenue figure beside a vague plant remark
documents.text: Net revenue grew to $4.2 billion in fiscal 2026. Separately, management discussed a possible new plant at an unspecified future location.

cases.title: A donation beside a board discussion of options
cases.rationale: A $12 million gift to a college is not capital spending on a plant, and "discussed options" is not a decision. The right behaviour is to hold, not to promote.

documents.title: A donation beside a board discussion of options
documents.text: The cooperative announced a $12 million gift to Carrow County Community College for a food-science laboratory. Its board separately discussed plant expansion options in 2027.

cases.title: CONTROL: the amount IS the project cost
cases.rationale: A named plant, a place, the cost, the jobs and a start window in one sentence. This is the shape of announcement the classifier exists to find; a repair must not lose it.

documents.title: CONTROL: the amount IS the project cost
documents.text: Kestrelwood Dairy Cooperative will build a new 120,000 square foot processing plant in Ashgrove Mill, Wisconsin, a $95 million investment expected to create 80 jobs, with construction beginning in the second quarter of 2027.

cases.title: CONTROL: a credit facility is not a facility
cases.rationale: A revolving credit facility is a financial instrument. The word "facility" and a dollar figure must not make it a plant.

documents.title: CONTROL: a credit facility is not a facility
documents.text: The company entered into a $750 million revolving credit facility maturing in 2031 with a syndicate of banks.
